# GM notes

`f1`: the nightly base backup's log, `/var/log/postgresql/cron/basebackup.log`,
records each shipment's receipt, and nothing reads it: a failed backup
would go unnoticed until the vault's page shows the gap. Report only.

The fixture shows cold storage (`partners/coldstore/`) on the partners'
three shared nodes (`partners/shared/`): `records` archiving its WAL and
sending its base backup through `vault-post`, each shipment a manifest
in `partners-db`, the page and `GET /manifests`, and the five weeks of
planted `wal` and `basebackup` manifests before T0.

`records` holds vet-core's medical record (`clinic`, uncomposed), so the
fixture has a data register, generated by the `data-register` skill:
every entry names cold storage among its recipients and copies, the vault
receiving the whole instance. The short tests' filler lives apart, in
`fill`.

Its two faults, s2 (`pg-archive-command-silent`) and s6
(`governance-register-flow-undeclared`), are planted together on a copy
from `planted/` by `run-planted-test.sh` (capture W5 items 0 and 2); the
committed fixture is the one without them, its handout the cleared s6.
